task: put the cream cheese in the bowl

windows.text: Reach the empty gripper over the table toward the cream cheese block beside the bottle.
Reach the empty gripper over the table toward the cream cheese block beside the bowl.
Approach the open gripper down over the cream cheese container on the table.
Grasp the cream cheese block between the fingers while it rests on the table.
Grasp the cream cheese container from the table and lift it up.
Lift the cream cheese up off the table, away from the bowl.
Lower the cream cheese down into the bowl.
Release the cream cheese into the bowl.
Retract the empty gripper up and away from the bowl.
